evidence: The attached 0.95 Run log contains a fatal UI-thread COMException 0x80263001 in WPF theme-change handling when desktop composition was disabled.
The report says the error popup appeared unexpectedly and does not give a reproduction sequence.

Current Run registers a dispatcher exception handler and its own ThemeManager has retry handling for composition-disabled failures: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher/Helper/ThemeManager.cs. The attached stack enters WPF's system theme handler, so that retry is not proven to cover it.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate Run's composition-disabled theme crash
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A composition transition during a WPF system theme update may trigger the crash; the exact transition and current-version behavior are unknown.
plan: Obtain the event immediately preceding the popup and current version.
Reproduce that transition while Run is active and identify whether WPF's system theme callback still raises the same exception.
If current code remains affected, investigate a safe theme-update recovery at the actual failing boundary and test normal and disabled composition transitions.
verification: The verified transition no longer terminates Run and ordinary theme changes remain functional.
